#!/bin/sh
# roblox-external-linux-001 — Void Linux external (self-contained, folder + builder in same payload)
# Fetch: xbps-fetch <paste-url> -o /tmp/f.txt && sha256sum /tmp/f.txt && rm -rf /tmp/roblox-external-linux-001 && sh /tmp/f.txt /tmp/roblox-external-linux-001 && sh /tmp/roblox-external-linux-001/setup.sh
set -u
UPDATE=001
SOURCE_COMMIT="4e9d69a"
ARCHIVE_SHA256=fa1c124e692ff76b949529b053bde312aa98a1a023437ea78a501b3d4b15cec6
FILES=158
PAYLOAD_SHA256=da6d17e2da7354dd06253c7a0a7108b9feee65adcd54d8439e800859f04ce3e3
[ -f "$0" ] || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=run-from-file"; exit 1; }
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=usage: sh /path/to/roblox-external-linux-001.txt /absolute/dir"; exit 1; }
DEST=$1
case "$DEST" in /*|[A-Za-z]:/*) ;; *) echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=absolute required"; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=target-already-exists:$DEST — run: rm -rf $DEST"; exit 1; fi
for c in base64 tar sha256sum mktemp; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=missing:$c"; exit 1; }; done
TMP=$(mktemp -d) || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=mktemp"; exit 1; }
b64d() { base64 -d "$1" 2>/dev/null || base64 -D "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
sed -n '/^__ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_PAYLOAD__$/,$p' "$0" | tail -n +2 > "$TMP/b64.txt"
b64d "$TMP/b64.txt" > "$TMP/src.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=base64"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
GOT=$(sha256sum "$TMP/src.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "$ARCHIVE_SHA256" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=archive-sha want=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 got=$GOT"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p "$DEST" || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=mkdir"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
tar -xzf "$TMP/src.tar.gz" -C "$DEST" || { echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=tar"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
rm -rf "$TMP"
GOT2=$(cd "$DEST" && find . -type f | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2"
if [ "$GOT2" != "$PAYLOAD_SHA256" ]; then echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_FAIL=payload-sha want=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 got=$GOT2"; exit 1; fi
echo "ROBLOX_EXTERNAL_LINUX_001_DONE=YES"
echo "Payload at $DEST — contains the folder + builder setup.sh that compiles from core files in same folder."
ls -lh "$DEST/setup.sh" "$DEST/CMakeLists.txt" 2>&1 | head -n 10
echo "Next: sh $DEST/setup.sh   (installs deps via xbps + cmake -B build && cmake --build build)"
# inverse — print what was just extracted (for receipts)
echo "--- inverse ---"
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_WANT=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT PAYLOAD_SHA256_WANT=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2 FILES=$FILES DEST=$DEST"
exit 0
